programme.title: Sniper: No Nation
programme.desc: A covert operation in Costa Verde explodes into an international scandal, and the U.S. government responds by disavowing the Global Response & Intelligence Team (G.R.I.T.), branding its operatives as terrorists. Hunted by the very country he served, Ace sniper Brandon Beckett goes AWOL only to learn that the Phoenix Rebellion, his last remaining allies, has been decimated by the Iron Legion, a mercenary force working for Costa Verde's ruthless Prime Minister.

programme.title: YAGA
programme.desc: The missing persons investigation is a murder; Carson and Rapp must work together to figure out who might have wanted the victim dead.

programme.title: The Grizzlie Truth
programme.desc: Superfan filmmaker Kat Jayme investigates the abrupt move of her NBA hometown team, the Vancouver Grizzlies, to Memphis in 2001. Much more than a sore spot, it's an unsolved mystery and possibly a criminal conspiracy. The investigation becomes a love letter to the worst professional sports franchise in history and an exploration into the deep roots of fandom.

programme.title: Merry Pickleball Match
programme.desc: Tennis star Luke Hollis heads home for Christmas and discovers his family's racquet club is about to be sold.

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realizes that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.

programme.title: Thank God: Christmas at the Keller Ranch
programme.desc: An unexpected romance develops between a no-nonsense rancher and an injured hockey player as he undergoes equine-assisted therapy.

programme.title: Murder She Baked: A Deadly Recipe
programme.desc: Bakery owner Hannah Swensen just can't keep her hands out of the batter when murder stirs things up in Lake Eden, Minn.

programme.title: Murder, She Baked: Just Desserts
programme.desc: Hannah Swensen is chosen as a guest for the first Eden Lake Dessert Bake-Off, but when fellow judge, coach Boyd Watson is found murdered, Hannah takes it upon herself to find out who killed Boyd Watson.

programme.title: Secret Headquarters
programme.desc: Friendship and courage take center stage when Charlie and his friends stumble upon the headquarters of the Guard and realize the world's most powerful superhero is Charlie's dad. When an evil businessman sends in a team to infiltrate the lair and retrieve the Guard's energy source, the youngsters spring into action and turn the tables on the intruders.

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: When a young woman is killed by a shark while skinny-dipping near the New England tourist town of Amity Island, police chief Martin Brody (Roy Scheider) wants to close the beaches, but mayor Larry Vaughn (Murray Hamilton) overrules him, fearing that the loss of tourist revenue will cripple the town. Ichthyologist Matt Hooper (Richard Dreyfuss) and grizzled ship captain Quint (Robert Shaw) offer to help Brody capture the killer beast, and the trio engage in an epic battle of man vs. nature.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
programme.desc: Bitten by a radioactive spider in the subway, Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales suddenly develops mysterious powers that transform him into the one and only Spider-Man. When he meets Peter Parker, he soon realizes that there are many others who share his special, high-flying talents. Miles must now use his newfound skills to battle the evil Kingpin, a hulking madman who can open portals to other universes and pull different versions of Spider-Man into our world.

programme.title: YAGA
programme.desc: Rapp and Carson investigate Geena and Lily Sandeson, as they attempt to connect them to Henry's disappearance.

programme.title: Yellowjackets
programme.desc: Everyone comes home, not everyone comes back; that's what the therapists are going to tell you; the team faces an inquisition sooner than they imagined.

programme.title: One Battle After Another
programme.desc: Bob is a washed-up revolutionary who lives in a state of stoned paranoia, surviving off-grid with his spirited and self-reliant daughter, Willa. When his evil nemesis resurfaces and Willa goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her as both father and daughter battle the consequences of their pasts.

programme.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
programme.desc: The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without a trace. Eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she's returned to them. However, what should be a joyful reunion soon turns into a living nightmare as she starts to transform into something truly horrifying.

programme.title: All's Fair in Love & Mahjong
programme.desc: A school nurse turns her love of the game mahjong into a new path, inspired by a jovial contractor fixing up her home, who encourages her to take a chance on the future.

programme.title: All Heart: A Rugby Story
programme.desc: Check out the culmination of years of sacrifice, hard work and preparation by the women's national team; a mix of veteran players, young rising superstars and semi-professionals who play overseas.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Lacey is suspicious of the illegal duplication of Dog River money; Hank gets a case of pink eye, causing Brent and Wanda to panic in Corner Gas; Karen is frustrated with Davis.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Emma goes Christmas shopping early making everyone curious to find out what they are getting.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: Bash's focus is split between the needs of patients in two countries; Dr. Bishop's emergency department goals are met with mixed support.

programme.title: The Sweater
programme.desc: A French-Canadian boy endures the terrible shame when he receives the hockey sweater of the wrong team.

programme.title: Elli and Her Monster Team
programme.desc: A homeless ghost seeking belonging at a Ghost Train draws unwanted outside attention, forcing her and its monster residents to embark on a quest to save their home and her chance at finding family.

programme.title: Fall Into Winter
programme.desc: Life quickly changes for Kerry as she has to work alongside her high school nemesis, Brooks, an old friend of her brother's who unexpectedly buys into Kerry's family-owned candy shop.

programme.title: Wrong Husband
programme.desc: After a mysterious death, Kaujak and Sapa are separated despite being promised to each other at birth. With the help of spirit guides, efforts are made to restore harmony.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mysteries
programme.desc: A bass player is found dead before a planned tour with a big country singer.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mysteries
programme.desc: Jenn finds the body of a local college history professor hidden in a suit of armor she purchased; as more murders occur, she finds herself caught in the killer's web.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mystery: A Case of Murder
programme.desc: After buying an old reel-to-reel recorder at a garage sale, Jenn discovers that it includes the sound of a man pleading for his life.

programme.title: The Day the Earth Blew Up: A Looney Tunes Movie
programme.desc: Porky Pig and Daffy Duck become Earth's only hope when their antics at the local bubble-gum factory uncover a secret alien mind-control plot. Faced with cosmic odds, they must save their town and the world while not driving each other totally loony.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: James Bond (Pierce Brosnan) is captured by North Korean agents and must serve a grueling prison sentence. He's finally released, and is convinced that someone in his own agency betrayed him. He escapes from custody and travels to Cuba, hot on the heels of Zao (Rick Yune), the agent who put Bond behind bars. Meanwhile, Bond begins romancing NSA agent Jinx (Halle Berry) as he uncovers a scheme concocted by Zao and British millionaire Graves (Toby Stephens), involving a highly destructive laser.

programme.title: All Night Wrong
programme.desc: Gary and Ell expect a straightforward hookup after meeting online. Instead, they get a suspicious motel clerk, a stolen car, a backpack full of cash and a body. Too compromised to call police, the two decide to handle it themselves. But the body won't stay dead and a cryptic plea sends them chasing a trail of blackmail, betrayal and lost love before the night's true villain is revealed.

programme.title: Power Ballad
programme.desc: When Rick, a past-his-prime wedding singer, meets fading boy-band star Danny during a gig, the two bond over music and a late-night jam session. But when Danny turns one of Rick's songs into the hit that reignites his career, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves -- even if it means risking everything he cares about.

programme.title: Sainte Barbe
programme.desc: An inventive young boy tries to maintain the connection with his rebellious grandfather even beyond death.

programme.title: Triangle of Sadness
programme.desc: Two social media influencers get a free trip on a luxury yacht with a group of billionaires. But a series of unfortunate events soon shifts the balance of power between the wealthy guests and the staff.

programme.title: Nickel Boys
programme.desc: Elwood Curtis' college dreams are shattered when he's sentenced to Nickel Academy, a brutal reformatory in the Jim Crow South. Clinging to his optimistic worldview, Elwood strikes up a friendship with Turner, a fellow Black teen who dispenses fundamental tips for survival.

programme.title: YAGA
programme.desc: Rapp and Carson investigate Geena and Lily Sandeson, as they attempt to connect them to Henry's disappearance.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Karen and Davis figure out a way to get Emma to do free cleaning.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Oscar and Emma discover an easy way to make some fast money; Davis decides to take off with Brent's car.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: Bash draws on his war zone experience when extreme weather causes the hospital to lose power.

programme.title: Mistletoe Time Machine
programme.desc: Three ex-best friends are forced back together when a magical incident sends them back to a pivotal moment in their shared past.

programme.title: Licence to Kill
programme.desc: James Bond (Timothy Dalton) takes on his most-daring adventure after he turns renegade and tracks down one of the international drug cartel's most-brutal and powerful leaders. After the murder of his just-married friend, he is fighting not only for country and justice, but for personal revenge!

programme.title: A Christmas Star
programme.desc: An astronomer predicts that a new meteor shower will appear over a tiny town, but she must convince the locals to help with her discovery at the expense of a Christmas tradition.

programme.title: Site Unseen: An Emma Fielding Mystery
programme.desc: Archaeologist Emma Fielding unearths evidence of a 17th-century coastal Maine settlement that predates Jamestown, but the dead body that accompanies it embroils Emma and her students in a different kind of investigation.

programme.title: Emma Fielding Mysteries
programme.desc: Emma is hired to consult on the acquisition of a castle-like estate that local legends claim carries a curse.

programme.title: Emma Fielding Mysteries
programme.desc: While hosting a gathering of the Association for the Study of American Archaeology, Emma Fielding is thrust into the middle of a murder mystery when the president of her organization is poisoned on the eve of announcing her successor.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Spawned from a lab experiment gone awry, teenage terrapins Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello and Raphael live in the sewers beneath New York. Although their rodent sensei, Splinter, advises against showing themselves above ground, the justice-loving, pizza-eating brothers can't stand idly by while evil Shredder and his minions terrorize the city. With help from intrepid reporter April O'Neil (Megan Fox) and her cameraman (Will Arnett), the Turtles set out to save New York.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The turtles face a new challenge when Shredder escapes from custody and joins forces with Baxter Stockman, a mad scientist who plans to use a serum to take over the world. Along for the ride are Bebop and Rocksteady, two dimwitted henchmen who provide plenty of muscle. Luckily, the turtles have their own allies in April O'Neil, Vernon Fenwick and Casey Jones, a hockey-masked vigilante. As the pizza-loving heroes prepare for battle, the notorious Krang also emerges to pose an even greater threat.

programme.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Volunteers at the Palestine Red Crescent Society stay on the phone with a 6-year-old girl who gets trapped in a car in war-torn Gaza.

programme.title: The Testament of Ann Lee
programme.desc: Revered by her followers, Ann Lee preaches gender and social equality as the founder of the devotional sect the Shakers.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: The civilisation of Panem is consumed by a bloody civil war. Reluctant rebel leader Katniss Everdeen leads a band of her allies on a mission to end the conflict at one stroke by assassinating the despotic President Snow - but faces many dangers as she closes in on her target. Conclusion of the sci-fi adventure series based on Suzanne Collins' novels, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Donald Sutherland and Philip Seymour Hoffman in his final role.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: A totalitarian future holds an annual nationally televised event in which two children from each of its regions fight to the death until only one remains. A teenage girl takes her younger sister's place in the games and must pit her wits against the deadly combat skills of her rivals. Sci-fi adventure based on Suzanne Collins' novel, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Woody Harrelson and Elizabeth Banks.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen's victory in a televised death match makes her a focus for revolution against the totalitarian nation she lives in. The rulers of the regime plot to crush dissent with a new series of games, in which past champions battle it out. Sci-fi adventure sequel based on the second book in Suzanne Collins' trilogy of novels, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Liam Hemsworth, Donald Sutherland and Philip Seymour Hoffman.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen is brought to a secretive underground society following the destruction of the televised deathmatch. She becomes the figurehead of a revolution against the despotic Panem regime, while her friend Peeta remains a captive of its tyrannical president. Part one of the two-part conclusion to the sci-fi adventure series, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Julianne Moore and Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Christmas Classics
programme.desc: A festive special highlights a number of classic Christmas films, from the Grinch's Christmas mischief to the romance of Last Christmas.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: A mischievous trio of talking chipmunks invade a struggling songwriter's home. When the furry critters demonstrate a remarkable talent for singing, he agrees to help them find fame and fortune. However, an unscrupulous record company boss has other plans. Children's comedy, starring Jason Lee and David Cross, with the voices of Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: The singing trio are left in the care of their manager's nephew and try to save a school's music programme by winning a battle-of-the-bands competition. However, they encounter fierce rivalry from another group of musical rodents. Comedy, starring Zachary Levi, Jason Lee and David Cross, with the voices of Justin Long and Christina Applegate.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: The singing rodents cause mayhem while performing on a tropical cruise, before they find themselves stranded on a desert island. As they search for a way to get back to civilisation, it becomes clear that they are not alone. Comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Jenny Slate, with the voices of Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The singing rodents mistakenly come to the conclusion that their human friend Dave intends to get rid of them when he proposes to his girlfriend in Miami. With only three days until Dave pops the question, the trio embark on a desperate road trip across America to sabotage his romantic plans. Family comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Kimberly Williams-Paisley.
